Photo 1 shows two white industrial sewing machines side by side, both with 'brother' branding visible on the front.

The machines appear to be heavy-duty, with large metal frames and industrial-style components.

Close-up photos of the needle, presser foot, feed dogs, and motor connections.

response.reason: The model and brand are identifiable from photo 2, but critical functional and condition details are missing. Without proof of operation and condition, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be treated as potentially non-functional or damaged.
